run_sav_evaluation: run the SA-V evaluator to compare predicted masks against ground truth masks using the benchmark function
run_strict_evaluation: run the SA-V evaluator in strict mode to verify every ground truth video has a matching prediction
run_quiet_evaluation: run the SA-V evaluator quietly without printing evaluation information to stdout
run_multi_process_evaluation: run the SA-V evaluator with a custom number of concurrent processes for faster evaluation
run_evaluation_no_skip: run the SA-V evaluator without skipping the first and last annotated frames during evaluation
